# Order Status's

## Overview

Every order in OrderHub moves through a series of statuses that reflect its progress from receipt to completion. Some transitions happen automatically based on job progress, while others are set manually.

## Order Statuses

### Pending
The order has been received but not yet acknowledged. This is the default status for all new orders, including those imported via the API or Pixfizz.

Sales started at the till also begin here. A till sale is saved as Pending until payment goes through, and shows a **Payment not completed** label on the orders list. Nothing is sent to production until it is confirmed or paid. See **Pending Orders from the Till**.

### Confirmed
The order has been reviewed and accepted. For Pixfizz orders, this status is set automatically when a confirmation payload is received. Payment references are captured at this stage.

### In Production
Work has begun on the order's jobs. This status is typically set manually when production starts.

### Ready
All work is complete and the order is ready for collection or dispatch. **This status can be set automatically** — see the automation section below.

### Shipped
The order has been dispatched to the customer. When a shipping label is purchased, the order is automatically moved to this status.

### Completed
The order is fully fulfilled. This is the final status and indicates the order lifecycle is complete.

### Cancelled
The order has been cancelled and no further work will be done. Any stock the order was holding is returned to your shelf count.

---

## Automatic Status Updates

OrderHub includes automation that links **job statuses** to **order statuses**, reducing manual work.

### Jobs drive the order to "Ready"

When **all jobs** on an order reach the **Completed** status, the order is automatically moved to **Ready**. This means you don't need to manually update the order — just mark each job as complete and the system handles the rest.

### Order status drives jobs

The reverse also applies. When an order is manually updated to **Ready**, **Shipped**, or **Completed**, any jobs that are not yet completed will be **automatically marked as Completed**. This ensures jobs and orders stay in sync.

### Summary

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| All jobs marked **Completed** | Order moves to **Ready** automatically |
| Order set to **Ready** | All incomplete jobs marked **Completed** |
| Order set to **Shipped** | All incomplete jobs marked **Completed** |
| Order set to **Completed** | All incomplete jobs marked **Completed** |
| Shipping label purchased | Order moves to **Shipped** automatically |

---

## Pixfizz Orders

For orders originating from Pixfizz, notifications are sent back to Pixfizz only when an order is manually moved to **Completed** or automatically moved to **Shipped** via a shipping label. The automatic transition to **Ready** (from job completion) does **not** trigger a Pixfizz notification — this ensures customers receive a single, clear notification.

## API Updates

The OrderHub API also supports updating order statuses via the `update-order-status` endpoint. The same automation rules apply: setting an order to Ready, Shipped, or Completed via the API will automatically complete all associated jobs.
